neighbours.label: a passive participle or preposition that attaches the manner, place or date to a described practice or work (is practiced with, was written by X in <year>, taken in)

Our wedding pictures were taken in a garden by the lake.
Origami is traditionally done with a single square sheet of paper.
The cathedral was designed by Gaudí in the late nineteenth century.
Yoga is usually practiced on a thin rubber mat.

notes: Card flags broad (1% of tokens). Top: ' in' after 'written by <author>' before a year, 'practiced with', 'taken in'. Probe: 'practiced with' 0.45, 'written by Burns in 1788' 0.31, 'published by Penguin last year' low.
